listing_info.description: Gorgeous waterfront lake house with a private sand beach perfect for relaxing with family and friends during any season. During the winter, our outdoor hot tub is a perfect way to enjoy the season while staying warm and comfortable. With the frozen lake, it's the perfect time to go ice skating, ice fishing, and enjoy over 90 miles of snowmobiling trails around us. During summer, you can paddle on the lake, kayak and jet ski. In the fall, you can watch the leaves change colors. Come enjoy!

listing_info.listing_name: Modern Lake House| Private beach| Near White Mtns
listing_info.description:
Welcome to the Ticket to Paradise Lake House on Balch Lake! Steps from snowmobile trails and a short drive to hiking, skiing and shopping in North Conway. Relax and enjoy the breathtaking views of a newly renovated contemporary lakefront home, which is perfect for families and friends seeking a peaceful getaway. We’re tucked away in a secluded cove with 1.5 acres of land and 169 feet of lake front, surrounded by the sounds of nature. Balch Lake is a 577-acre lake located on the NH-ME border.

The space
Where You’ll Stay
Come enjoy the serene and cozy lakefront home away from home! The homey ambiance allows you to unwind from everyday life. Experience waking up to the sunrise, sipping coffee or tea on the front deck overlooking the lake.

We’ve partnered with Mosquito Squad to treat the property with an all-natural spray for mosquito and tick control.

This three-level contemporary home can sleep 8-10 people. It has 4 bedrooms, 2 full baths and 1 ½ bath. The main level contains 1 bedroom with a bunk bed (king and twin mattresses) and a full bath. The lower level includes a master suite with a king-size bed and a full bath and the top level has 2 bedrooms - one with 2 full-size beds and the other with a king size bed and a ½ bath. We also have a portable oversized playpen for infants or toddlers (can be used as a bed as well) and a high chair.

The home has an open floor-plan living space. We have brand-new kitchen appliances, quartz countertops, an electric stove, a microwave, a refrigerator and a dishwasher. Our kitchen is fully stocked with dinner and bakeware, glasses, utensils and children's dish sets. We have a two-level large deck with a gas grill and patio seating overlooking the lake.

Bathrooms come complete with bath towels and toiletries, including shampoo, conditioner, body wash, and toilet paper. For your convenience, there's a laundry room with a washer and dryer on the lower level. Your lakeside haven awaits, promising comfort and a touch of luxury!

Guest access
Guest have the entire house and grounds to themselves.

Other things to note
Wintertime Fun:
There are lots of activities within an hour of our home.
- Ride right out to snowmobile trails on the New Hampshire Bureau of Trails
- Ice fishing at Tim Moore Outdoors at Lake Winnipesaukee - just over 30 minutes away.
- Skiing, snowboarding, tubing and ice skating are available at King Pine (30 minutes) and Gunstock Mountain Resort (40 minutes).
- North Conway is an hour away and includes historic sightseeing, dining, shops and unlimited hiking in the White Mountains.
- A little further away enjoy family activities at Santa’s Village and the NH Ice Castles.

Dining / Groceries:
- Within 5 minutes: Blue Bay Seafood & Steaks, Knotty Pine Grill and Tavern, Country Goods & Groceries
- Within 10-15 minutes: Poor People’s Pub, Tumbledown Farm to Fork, Lino's (breakfast, lunch), Wakefield House of Pizza, Wakefield Inn & Restaurant, Wonton’s Chinese Restaurant, Lovell Lake Village Market and Hannaford Supermarket

Summertime Fun:
Relax by the private beach, take the canoe, kayaks or paddleboards for a ride or enjoy each other's company by the fire pit. We have outdoor lawn games such as corn hole, Kan Jam disc toss and many more. The water level in the lake can fluctuate, so we kindly ask you to refrain from jumping / diving off the dock.

North Conway is less than an hour away and includes historic sightseeing, dining, and shops. There is unlimited hiking in White Mountain National Park and don’t miss Diana’s Baths, a favorite for families.

GUESTS USING KAYAKS, CANOES AND ANY OTHER WATER ACTIVITIES AT THEIR OWN RISK. GUEST SWIM AT THEIR OWN RISK. LIFE JACKETS MUST BE WORN WHEN ON A FLOATING VESSEL.

Welcome to Lake A Dream, our beautiful waterfront home with private sandy beach on Belleau Lake. Perfect for couples, friends, and families. It offers indoor-outdoor living, open concept main level, game room, and more! Enjoy your morning coffee on the balcony taking in lake views, explore the lake on kayaks or paddle boards and roast marshmallows under the stars. In the winter, stay active skating, snowmobiling or cozy up by the fireplace. Have fun no matter the season!

The space
Lake A Dream is a beautifully updated and tastefully decorated, 2250 sq ft, three level home right on Belleau Lake! You will feel relaxed and on vacation as soon as you enter the property.

Main Level:
- Open concept living room - dining room - kitchen so you can carry-on conversation.
- Spacious, bright and sunny living room with large slider and windows with direct balcony access and expansive lake views.
- Very well equipped kitchen for all your cooking needs.
- Dining table with seating for 6 (plus 2 extra foldable chairs available).
- Sunroom with gas fireplace and access to balcony and separate grilling deck (grill available).

Lower Level:
- Direct access to the covered patio and beach.
- Game room for indoor fun! Large TV, arcade games, board games, and bar for entertaining. There is also a work-space with stand-up desk and office chair.

Outdoor living:
- Balcony off the main living space with rocking chairs and umbrella-covered dining area with seating for 8.
- Covered patio includes comfy patio furniture, dinning table & chairs.
- Private sandy beach perfect for lounging in the sun or building sand castles, complete with Adirondack chairs and a firepit.
- Two docks with additional seating.
- 2 paddle boards, 2 single kayaks, tandem kayak, canoe, and 2 pedal boats; life jackets in all sizes provided.

Bedrooms:
- Master bedroom on upper level with King-size bed, two dressers, large closet and workspace (stand-up desk and office chair).
- Bedroom 2 on upper level with Queen-size bed and dresser.
- Bedroom 3 on upper level with two Twin XL beds and dresser.
- Bedroom 4 on mail level with Bunk bed and dresser.
- TVs in all bedrooms; upper level bedrooms have lake views and blackout shades.
- Window AC units provided during summer months.

Bathrooms:
- Full bath #1 on main level with shower and laundry (washer/dryer).
- Full bath #2 on upper level with shower.
- Half bath on lower level, right off the game room and outside patio.

Parking:
- In driveway for 4 vehicles.

Activities and attractions:
- On site: swimming, kayaking, paddle boarding, fishing, ice-skating, ice-fishing, snowmobiling (when lake is frozen).
- Minutes away: Seven Lakes Snowmobile Club House & Corridor 19, Province Lake Golf Course, Province Mountain, ATV trails.
- 30 min drive: Wolfeboro / Lake Winnipesaukee, Lake Ossipee, King Pine Ski Area (skiing & snow tubing).
- 1 hour drive: North Conway, Portsmouth, Portland, skiing (Cranmore, Attitash, Gunstock, Pleasant Mtn), snow tubing & mountain coaster (Cranmore), mountain biking (Cranmore, Hurricane, Attitash), Kancamagus highway, White Mountains.

IMPORTANT:
1. Our Lake House can accommodate up to 8 guests including children. It is NOT okay to sneak in additional people or think they can sleep on couches/blow-up mattresses. Please don’t book our property if your party is larger than 8. We will ask additional persons to leave immediately and will impose a minimum of $250 per person per day fine if you don’t comply and can be applied retroactively. We may make an exception for a small child but that has to be disclosed and agreed upon prior to booking.
2. This is a NON-SMOKING property, inside and outside. No smoking or vaping is allowed anywhere on the property.
3. There is no public boat ramp on Belleau Lake and no boat rental facility.

NH M&R License: 106506

Guest access
Keypad entry. Code will be provided prior to arrival.

Other things to note
Provided:
- Linens, bath towels and beach towels. Please do not use bath towels as beach towels!
- Hand soap and laundry detergent.
- Phone/tablet charging stations and cables throughout the house.
- For coffee lovers, drip coffee maker, pour over, as well as Nespresso maker (limited number of cups provided, you can bring more, we have the Nespresso Essenza Mini).
- Cooking oil and basic spices.
- Step stools in all bathrooms, pack-n-play and booster/high chair.

Things to note:
- Outdoor furniture and equipment (paddle boards, kayaks, etc.) are put away for the winter and will not be available Nov - mid-May.
- Fire pit usage may be restricted by state/local ordinances (e.g. fire ban due to drought conditions) and due to weather (e.g. snow cover).
- The balcony and patio will be cleaned before your arrival but since those are outside spaces, you'll likely bring in some sand from the beach and cobwebs may appear in the outdoor living areas during your stay. In the fall, leaves can a cumulate within minutes. We provide a leaf blower and brooms if it's necessary for you to sweep the space during your stay.
- The water level in the lake is controlled by the dam and it’s lower by a few feet during the cold season (Nov/Dec - Apr/May). When this happens the docks will be completely out of the water. We have no control over it.

Welcome to your perfect getaway on Lake Winnipesaukee! This year-round lakefront cottage and guest house combo offers the ideal setting for family vacations, friend getaways, or peaceful retreats.

The space
🌊 Breathtaking Lake Views + Private Dock
Wake up to panoramic views of the lake from nearly every room in the main house. Step outside to a spacious wrap-around deck or head down to your private dock perfect for swimming, boating, or just soaking up the sun. The water depth is about 5' at the end of the dock, making it ideal for lakeside fun.

🏡 The Main House (Sleeps 7)
3 Bedrooms:

Bedroom 1: Full bed with attached ¾ bath
Bedroom 2: Twin bunk beds + 1 single twin
Bedroom 3: Full bed

All bedrooms have sliding doors leading directly onto the deck with stunning lake views. You'll also love the spacious bedrooms, a wealth of closet space, and the expansive pantry great features for families and/or longer vacations!

Living Spaces:
Bright living room, cozy den with pull-out sofa, dining area, and fully equipped kitchen
Workspace for remote work or planning adventures
2.5 Bathrooms for convenience

🛏 The Guest House (Sleeps 2) AVAILABLE JUNE 1 - NOVEMBER 15 ONLY
1 Bedroom with a full-size bed
Living room with pull-out sofa
3/4 bath
Kitchenette
Private deck and separate entrance
(Note: You’ll have full access to the Main House during your stay. Please keep in mind that the Guest House is closed for the winter beginning November 15 reducing total capacity to 7)

Cooling is provided via mini-split in the guest house, while the main house includes ceiling fans and portable fans for your comfort.

🧺 Amenities
Air conditioning
Washer & dryer
Full kitchen
Gas grill
Fire pit for evening s’mores under the stars
Lots of games and books for all ages
Access to a community beach and tennis courts

🌴 Community Beach & Tennis Courts
Beach: Approximately 100 yards from the front door, just a short walk along the main road.
Tennis Courts: About half a mile walk along the main road.
Both the beach and courts are easy walking distance and free to use during your stay.


✅ Why You'll Love It
Two separate living spaces ideal for multi-family or group stays

All bedrooms in the main house have deck access and lake views

Enjoy the peaceful sounds of the lake year-round

Minutes from local shops, hiking trails, and charming New Hampshire towns

This is the lake vacation you’ve been dreaming of, come and make lasting memories at our Windemere lakefront retreat!

Guest access
You’ll have full access to the Main House during your stay. Please keep in mind that the Guest House is closed for the winter beginning November 15.

Other things to note
Guest Support Hours:
Our customer support team is available to assist you daily from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM.

You’ll have full access to the Main House during your stay. Please keep in mind that the Guest House is closed for the winter beginning November 15 reducing total capacity to 7

Grill: We ask our guests to clean the grill after use or before check out as a courtesy to the next guests otherwise, additional $35 fee will be charged for cleaning the grill. Thank you!

Ice: Please note that we do not have an ice maker available on the premises, we kindly request that guests bring their own ice if needed.

Winter time: Given the harsh and unpredictable New England weather, we do not guarantee that decks will be cleared off during the winter time. We're hoping for your understanding!

Please remember to bring your own beach towels if you plan to visit the beach, as we only supply bath towels.

Most of all- HAVE FUN!

Enjoy easy access to town from this historic home. Relax on the deck overlooking Wolfeboro Bay. Enjoy a swim whenever you want.

There are 4-season activities in the area: bike, hiking and ski trails close by.

Private beach, raft (no dock), canoe/kayaks, and beach toys.

Great gathering place: our family has enjoyed many special events here!

HOWEVER, if you are looking for a place to have loud parties, this is not for you. This rental is in a neighborhood and we respect our neighbors.

The space
There is a well-equipped kitchen, formal dining room, and great room overlooking Lake Winnipesaukee. This great room opens onto a spacious deck. The first floor also has a bathroom with stall shower and an event room.

The second floor has a king suite with a privacy door and its own full bathroom.

There are 3 other bedrooms on the 2nd floor: one room with a queen, one with a set of twins and the final second floor bedroom has a set of twins that can be made into a queen bed. There is a 1/2 and a full bath with a tub also on the second floor.

So sorry but we do not allow pets on the property.

There are 2 parking spots in the garage spring through late fall and one parking space in the garage in the winter. Lots of creative ways to park other cars between the garage and the street and in the driveway.

Guest access
You can use all of the rooms though occasionally the library is off limits.

Other things to note
There are plenty of linens & towels. There is no AC but you will enjoy lovely breezes off the lake. We also have ceiling & portable fans to keep you cool.

listing_info.listing_name: Luxury Lake House +Hot Tub! Waterfront Magic in NH
listing_info.description:

Guest access
Smart Lock

listing_info.listing_name: Luxury Lakehouse| Sunsets| Cen. Air| Private Dock
listing_info.description:
Crystal clear Rust Pond contemporary waterfront home with picturesque lake views from every angle and multiple decks. Your vacation home has central AC for hot days and a cozy gas fireplace and central heat for chilly nights. Rust Pond is an oligotrophic lake with excellent swimming, SUP boarding, kayaking, fishing, etc. The home offers privacy in a peaceful lakeside setting, yet is just 10 mins from Wolfeboro downtown restaurants, farm to table fare, art galleries and boutique shopping.

The space
The house is freshly remodeled: light, airy, modern and beautiful with vaulted ceilings, large windows overlooking the lake from just about every room and streams of natural lighting. Your lakefront home away from home has been stylishly redesigned with high end furnishings and artistic touches for your iconic NH getaway.

We have 4 decks, all with water views:
1st right off the kitchen with a dinning table and chairs
2nd right in front of the living room with 4 lounger chairs
3rd right in front of the lower level
4th is a stand alone deck right over the stairs with a sectional seating arrangement and large umbrella for sunny days

Cleanliness is a top priority, and so we ask all guests to leave their shoes at the door. You can bring your home shoes if you feel more comfortable.

The living area features long, light filled windows overlooking the magnificent lake, plush leather sofa, and 2 comfy swivel egg chairs. There is a West Elm double chaise to relax, read and take in the view. Wifi available through out the property including the decks. We also have central air and heat to keep you comfortable throughout the stay. The lake house has lots of board games and books for all ages.

Throughout the house we have Casper mattresses for the most comfortable sleep during your stay. On the main floor are 2 bedrooms and a full bath. The second floor is an open loft overlooking the lake with a master en suite. The walkout lower level has an office with a Joybird Eliot Sleeper Sectional that pulls out into a queen foam mattress bed and its own private full bathroom. The house comfortably accommodates six (6) people.

We have 2 Bedrooms, 1 loft, one lower level room that can serve as bedroom or office and 3 full bathrooms:
(1) Master bedroom with King-Sized Bed, full bathroom and majestic views of water from the Loft. The loft overlooks the windows facing the water and there is no door to this room.
(2) A bedroom with bunk beds - full and twin
(3) A bedroom with 2 full size beds
(4) Lower level room with Joybird Eliot Sleeper Sectional that pulls our into a queen foam mattress bed and panoramic views of the lake. There is a full bathroom accessible from the lower level room.
Please Note: We provide enough pillows, blankets, comforters, linens and bath/hand/face/kitchen towels. Guests just have to bring their own beach towels.

A Chefs Kitchen ~ fully equipped with custom cabinets, granite countertops stainless steel appliances including a gas range, microwave, fridge/freezer, dishwasher, coffee maker, toaster, blender, cookware, dish ware, and flatware. Tea, coffee, basic spices and condiments included ~ we hope you enjoy!

Large Dock with water toys ~ 30x6 brand new dock with wide staircase to easily get to the water. In the summer your family can enjoy cooling off in the lake: kayaking, paddle boarding, and swimming. We provide outdoor toys for your enjoyment: 2 stand-up paddle boards, 1 kid kayak, 1 single adult kayak, 2 person inflatable kayak and a floating rubber dockie mat. Rust pond has some great fishing, which you can enjoy right from the dock. Plenty of life jackets available and recommended when using water toys.

Fire pit ~ We have a large patio overlooking the lake with an outdoor firepit to roast marshmallows and enjoy the lake. It is our favorite place to hangout when there is a little chill in the air.

ATTRACTIONS:
Wright Museum of World War II (4 mi), Castle in the Clouds - Lucknow Mansion (20 mi), North Conway Shopping Outlets (50 mi), Storyland Childrens Amusement Park (50 mi), Santa's Village in Jefferson, NH (92 mi), Journey to the North Pole in Conway, NH (45 mi)

RESTAURANTS - DOWNTOWN WOLFEBORO
Marker 21, El Centenario, Seven Suns Cafe, Garwoods, Nolans Brick Oven Pizzeria, Wolfeboro Dockside Grill and Dairy Bar, Bayside Grill and Tavern

BREWERIES AND WINERIES
Lone Wolfe Brewing Company (4 mi), Gilmanton Winery and Restaurant (26 mi)

HIKING:
Brewster Heath Preserve Walking Trail (2 mi), Sewall Woods (5mi), Mt Major ( 14.5 mi), Plummer's Ridge Forest & Farm Hiking Trails (17 mi), Castle in the Clouds (20 mi)

SKI RESORTS:
Wolfeboro Abenaki Ski Area(6 mi), Gunstock Mountain Resort(22 mi), Cranmore Ski Resort(45 mi), Attitash Resort(52 mi), Ragged Mountain Resort(55 mi)

CROSS COUNTRY SKIING/SNOWSHOEING:
Sewall Woods (5mi)
Nordic Skier Sports (for full ski and snow shoe rentals) (4mi)

GOLFING:
Kingswood Golf Club (2 mi), Lake Winnipesaukee Gold Club (6 mi), Farmington Country Club (21 mi)

WATER ACTIVITIES:
Wake Winni (2 mi), US Postal Service Delivery Boat (2 mi), Mt Washington Boat Cruise (2 mi), Goodhue Boat Rental (5 mi)

Every season on Rust pond has its own charm.

SUMMER:

You can also rent a boat at Goodhue boat rental (5 mi), to go tubing on Lake Winnipesaukee. Wake Winni water sports (3mi), has excellent wake surfing, water skiing and wake boarding lessons. Our kids learned how to water ski and wake board with Wake Winni! From the town docks (3 mi) you can also jump on the US Postal Service delivery boat and cruise around the lake delivering mail. Kids can help deliver the US Postal mail to all the islands in Winnipesaukee. (This is a favorite for our kids!) This is the best way to explore the entirety of the lake with the family.

FALL:
Autumn brings a crispness to the air and beautiful views of the fall foliage. There are great hiking trails close by, including Mt Major 14.5mi, Brewster Heath Preserve Walking Trail (2mi). We also have an outdoor fire pit to roast marshmallows and enjoy the lake.

WINTER:
In winter the lake freezes over, providing opportunities to explore the lake like never before - walking, snowshoeing, skating, or cross country skiing. Sewall woods (5mi) provides miles of groomed cross country skiing trails and snowshoeing paths. Nordic Skier Sports (4mi) provides the rentals and trail pass you need to enjoy a day out snowshoeing or cross country skiing. We are also (6mi) from Abenaki, (20mi) from Gunstock & (29mi) from Kingpine for skiing, snowboarding and snowtubing fun! Once back home snuggle up with a hot chocolate next to the gas stove and admire the views.

SPRING:
There are lots of great hikes in the area. Castle in the Clouds, Mt Major 14.5mi, Brewster Heath Preserve Walking Trail (2mi) are some of our favorites. You can also bring your bikes and enjoy nearby biking, such as the cotton valley rail trail(6 mi). We also have an outdoor fire pit to roast marshmallows and enjoy the lake.

Guest access
The entire lake house is yours during your stay. Prior to your arrival, you will receive a unique entry code for the unit front door so no need to worry about losing keys!

Other things to note
THERE ARE PARKING SPACES FOR 4 VEHICLES. THERE IS AN ADDITIONAL FEE FOR EACH ADDITIONAL GUEST BEYOND SIX.

In the winter months AWD vehicles are recommended as it is a gravel road. The road is plowed and sanded after every snow storm.

PLEASE include a few words about you and your guests ~ we love knowing a little about our visitors!

No parties, smoking or animals. Please note, we do not allow any animals. Our son is highly allergic to dander.

Please Read:
DO NOT CONSIDER THIS SITE IF YOU ARE HOSTING A PARTY OR EVENT. GROUPS OF 10 OR MORE ARE NOT ALLOWED. DISRUPTIVE NOISE LEVELS/MUSIC AT ANY TIME OF THE DAY GRAVELY JEOPARDIZE OUR FRIENDLY NEIGHBORHOOD RELATIONSHIPS AND WILL NOT BE TOLERATED. LAW ENFORCEMENT WILL BE CALLED IN & A NEGATIVE REVIEW WILL FOLLOW. WE KINDLY APPRECIATE YOUR CONSIDERATION ~

Hale Pau Hana. Hawaiian for "House of no work". Start your vacation and leave your worries behind. Enjoy this light and airy paradise. Bring the family/friends and enjoy the Hot tub, get warm by the giant fire pit, enjoy a BBQ on the massive deck, relax in the hammocks or just take a short 3 min stroll to the private association beach on the famous Lake Winnipesaukee!

The space
When reaching the property, you will enter through the garage. From there you will enter through the basement door. You will walk into the basement living room with TV and sound bar. There are Two bedrooms that have Queen size beds and each have their own ac/heating mini split. There is also a full size bathroom.

You will go up the 1st set of stairs to reach the main floor. The main floor consists of the open concept living room, dining room and kitchen, Primary bedroom with en suite bathroom, main bathroom, front door, front deck, 3 season room and Hot tub and 2nd set of stairs to the additional 2 bedrooms.


The primary bedroom has a King size bed and a heated en suite bathroom.

The living room has large wood burning fireplace and 4K TV with sound bar and Sonos speaker.

Kitchen has very large attached island that seats 5.

Main full size bathroom is heated and has a washer and dryer.

The 3 season room is great to have morning coffee and used to access the Back deck/Hot tub.

You can go out the front door to access the large front deck. There you will find a gas grill and Traegar smoker, bar height round table with umbrella with seating for 4. There is plenty of additional seating around the propane table fireplace.

The 2nd set of stairs takes you to 2 additional bedrooms. The first one has a Queen bed and the second has 3 twin-XL beds. Both have their own AC/heating mini split.

Guest access
Guest can access the entire home and nearly 1 acre property in the spring, fall and summer. In the winter, snow pack usually prevents most of the front deck use and back yard. There are two fire pits, one in the backyard and a large fire pit in the front yard guest can use to burn wood, roast hotdogs and cook smores during season. Firewood cut and stacked on property is available to use . Parking vehicles is not allowed in the garage. Guests can inquire about the golf cart rental rates and motor scooter rates. We have personal and property liability waivers each person driving and riding from each family must sign and send to us prior to renting.

Guest can access the association beach but must comply with association rules.

1. Pets leased and unleashed are not allowed on the beach unless passing thru to a boat.
2. Young Children must be supervised at all times.
3. The dumpsters in parking lot are for household trash only.
4. Small non-motorized boats, canoes and kayaks may be launched and retrieved from the beach.
5. No swimming, diving, playing or fishing off the boat docks.
6. Cars can drop off passengers but must be parked in the parking lot but not left overnight.
7. Limit use of tennis courts to 1 hour if others are waiting to play.
8. Speed limit is 15 Mph for all vehicles
9. No fireworks are allowed in beach area.
10. Chairs, tents or other personal items are to be removed from beach each day.
11. No Group flotation devices are allowed in association area.

Other things to note
There is a public boat ramp 2 min away and there is plenty of room to park your boat and trailer at our house.

We have an association boating dock you can use for as a “pickup spot” for your guests. It is fairly shallow water so no deep hull boats, it can range from 4 feet in spring to 2 in the late fall. Be very careful for moorings, buoys, and shallow rocks.

Front Deck is seasonal. We try to keep it open all year long, but copious amounts of snow may render it unusable.

Our max occupancy is 13, but extra guest fee apply after 11 guests.

Gather your friends and family and stay in this spacious Winnipesaukee Lakefront property in style. My modern design new construction home includes breathtaking lake views, a dock for your boat or personal water craft, the very best of lake swimming combined with soft sandbars for playing in this Alton Bay cove with 130 feet of shoreline, and outdoor decks and yard space so incredible you'll never want to go home. Come stay at my place and experience lake Winnipesaukee life at it's VERY best.

The space
5 bedroom, 4 bathroom home ideal for family gatherings with large lake facing decks and floor to ceiling glass. Excellent indoor/outdoor accommodations with a large lawn, private boat dock, and 130' of water front for lake swimming and play in Loon Cove with a private Cove enclosed by a rock jetty with 20" depth protected water for extra little ones. Kayaks available for use.

Guest access
Access provided via a custom lock code. Plenty of parking for 4 cars in private driveway.

Other things to note
Summer bookings are generally weekly only, Saturday afternoon arrival and Saturday morning departure. Reach out for possible exceptions.

listing_info.listing_name: New Construction, Walk to Town, Easy Lake access
listing_info.description: Walk to downtown Wolfeboro NH.    New to market 4,000SF new construction home features custom luxury living details, combined with fantastic communal space.   Sleeps 12 comfortably.  Great back yard, two car garage, beautiful chef's kitchen.   This house has two on-suite bathrooms in each king size bedroom, making this home great for 1 large family or 2 family sharing.   Wolfeboro offers swimming, boating, shopping, and great access to Lake Winnipesaukee.   Carry Beach, Goodhue Boat Marina
